children.name: Porphyra purpurea
children.description: Porphyra purpurea is a species of red algae in the order Bangiales.

children.name: Porphyra umbilicalis
children.description: Porphyra umbilicalis, commonly known as laver, is a species of seaweed in the genus Porphyra.

children.name: Pyropia acanthophora
children.authorship: (E.C.Oliveira & Coll) M.C.Oliveira, D.Milstein & E.C.Oliveira in Sutherland et al. 2011

children.name: Pyropia columbina
children.description: Pyropia columbina, Southern laver, karengo in the Māori language and luche in the Spanish language, is a species of edible seaweed traditionally harvested by South Island Māori in New Zealand and Chilote people in Chile.

children.name: Pyropia tenera
children.description: Pyropia tenera, also known as gim or nori, is a red algal species in the genus Pyropia.

children.name: Dione arcuata
children.description: Dione arcuata, commonly known as eyelash seaweed, is the only species of the red algae genus Dione.

children.name: Clymene coleana
children.description: Clymene coleana, formerly known as Porphyra cinnamomea, is a red alga species in the family Bangiaceae.
